title: Catalogue truth extraction — one spot, one run
description: What the extractor emits per spot. Shaped for direct ingestion into spot-readiness.js: `season` populates seasonStartMonth/seasonEndMonth, `prices[]` populates the spot_price rows. Every fact carries the page it came from, the moment that page was fetched, and the verbatim span that carries it — the quote is what makes the claim re-checkable by a machine rather than trusted.

slug.description: Spot slug. Must already exist; this pipeline never creates spots.

runId.description: Groups every emission from one pipeline run, so a bad model version can be reverted as a unit.

modelId.description: Exact model identifier, e.g. an NVIDIA NIM model slug. Required for accepted output; a fact whose producer is unknown cannot be re-audited.

verdict.description: accepted = write. hold = queue for the operator checklist. rejected = discard, spot stays needs-verification.

pagesFetched.description: Every page fetched this run, whether or not it yielded a fact. A page that produced nothing is evidence the fact is absent, which is a different finding from not having looked.

reasons.description: Required and non-empty when verdict is hold or rejected.

isoInstant.description: UTC, Z-suffixed. Matches the existing observedAt values in spot_price.

sourceTier.description: T1 the operator's own domain. T2 a page the operator demonstrably controls and that T1 links to (their booking platform, their official social page). T3 a municipal or tourist-board page. Anything else is not an allowed source and cannot appear here.

observedAt.description: MUST equal the fetchedAt of the matching pagesFetched entry. Not the model's idea of now.

sourceQuote.description: Verbatim span from the fetched page that carries this value, copied not paraphrased. The validator asserts it appears in that page's text after whitespace normalisation; if it does not, the fact is a fabrication and the row is rejected.

quoteLang.description: BCP-47 tag of the quote, e.g. fr. Quotes are never translated — translating is editing.

contentHash.description: Of the normalised text. Lets a later audit prove which bytes the quote was taken from.

yearRound.description: True only when the page says so in words. Never inferred from a 1..12 span, and never from an absence of closing dates.

wrapsYearEnd.description: Set when start > end. Legal, but flagged so a transposition does not pass silently.

currency.description: The catalogue spans FR CH DE BE GB TR IT LU IE. A currency outside this set means the wrong page was read.

label.description: The operator's own wording, in the operator's own language. Not translated.

confidence.description: The only value the catalogue holds today (269 of 269 rows). A fact that is not directly stated does not get a weaker confidence value — it does not get written.

score.description: Auditable by construction: total must equal the sum of components, so a score can be recomputed from its parts rather than trusted.

field.description: Dotted path, e.g. season.seasonEndMonth or prices[2].amount
